# SOMX-CORE

**Security-First Sovereign AI Core Platform**

Policy enforcement, secure agent execution, multi-model routing, audit trails, and AI governance in one core.



![CI](https://github.com/mascore7/somx-core/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)



## Features

- **Policy Enforcement**: every request is checked against sovereignty and security policies before execution.
- **Secure Agent Execution**: agents run in a controlled, fail-closed environment.
- **Multi-Model Routing**: route requests across multiple AI models through one gateway.
- **Audit Trails**: every decision and action is logged in a tamper-evident ledger.
- **AI Governance**: clear rules, accountability, and transparency for AI use.

## Architecture

```
Request -> Gatekeeper -> Policy Engine -> Model Router -> Ledger
```
